mapper.select: SELECT t_order_mould.order_line_no AS orderLineNo, t_order_mould.order_type AS orderType, t_order_mould.flow_protocol AS flowProtocol, t_order_mould.flow_reporting_cycle AS flowReportingCycle, t_order_mould.cash_transfer_cycle AS cashTransferCycle, t_order_mould.acceptance_payment_cycle AS acceptancePaymentCycle, t_order_mould.mode_of_transport AS modeOfTransport, t_order_mould.order_validity_days AS orderValidityDays, t_order_mould.delay_days AS delayDays, t_order_mould.new_terms AS newTerms, t_order_line.order_start_time AS orderStartTime, t_order_line.order_end_time AS orderEndTime FROM t_order_mould left join t_order_line t_order_line on t_order_mould.order_line_no = t_order_line.order_line_no WHERE t_order_mould.is_deleted = 0 AND t_order_mould.order_line_no = #{orderLineNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_order_mould SET status=#{status}, order_type = #{orderType}, flow_protocol = #{flowProtocol}, flow_reporting_cycle = #{flowReportingCycle}, cash_transfer_cycle = #{cashTransferCycle}, acceptance_payment_cycle = #{acceptancePaymentCycle}, mode_of_transport = #{modeOfTransport}, order_validity_days = #{orderValidityDays}, delay_days = #{delayDays}, new_terms = #{newTerms} WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND order_line_no = #{orderLineNo};
